verdict.rationale: A supported browser matrix is a fair question for a UI framework, but nothing in the evidence pack documents which browsers Solid officially supports. The only runtime-support statement covers server environments (Node LTS, Deno, Cloudflare Workers), which is a different matter from browser targets. Isolated reports of site examples failing on Android Chrome do not define a support matrix.

support.subject: As a developer, I know the framework's officially supported browser matrix so I can plan polyfills or decide when to drop legacy support
